units.source_text: 且说今春逝世的式部卿亲王有个女儿，

en.t: Now, the Prince Shikibu-kyo, who had died this spring, had a daughter,

units.source_text: 亲王夫人是她的后母，很不喜欢她。

en.t: and the prince’s wife was her stepmother, who disliked her very much.

units.source_text: 这后母的哥哥右马头，其人毫不足道，却恋慕这个女儿。

en.t: This stepmother’s elder brother, the Umanokami of the Right, was a man of no importance, yet he had fallen in love with the girl.

units.source_text: 后母不顾女儿委屈，答应把这女儿嫁给他。

en.t: Ignoring the girl’s distress, the stepmother agreed to marry her off to him.

units.source_text: 明石皇后偶然闻知此事，说道：“可惜啊！

en.t: When Empress Akashi happened to hear of this, she said, “What a pity!

units.source_text: 她父亲在日非常疼爱她，如今要被糟蹋了！”

en.t: While her father was alive, he loved her dearly, and now she is to be ruined!”

units.source_text: 这女儿也很悲伤，日夜愁叹。

en.t: The girl herself was deeply saddened and sighed in sorrow day and night.

units.source_text: 女儿的哥哥侍从便说：“既然皇后这样慈祥地关怀……”

en.t: The girl’s elder brother, the Jijū, then said, “Since the Empress is showing such gracious concern...”

units.source_text: 最近就把这妹妹送进宫中。

en.t: Soon afterward, he sent this younger sister into the palace.

units.source_text: 此女与大公主做伴，最为适当。

en.t: It was most fitting for this girl to serve as companion to the First Princess.

units.source_text: 因此特别受人尊敬。

en.t: For that reason, she was treated with special respect.

units.source_text: 然而身份自有规定，所以给她取名为宫君，

en.t: Yet rank had its own rules, and so she was given the name Miya no Kimi,

units.source_text: 但不穿侍女制服，只添一条侍女用的短裙。

en.t: but she did not wear a lady-in-waiting’s uniform; only a short skirt used by attendants was added to her dress.

units.source_text: 实在也是很委屈的。

en.t: This too was truly a painful humiliation.

units.source_text: 匂亲王闻知此事，想道：“恐怕只有这宫君，

en.t: When Prince Niou heard of this, he thought, “Perhaps only this Miya no Kimi

units.source_text: 相貌比得上我所恋慕的浮舟。

en.t: could rival in beauty the Ukifune whom I love.

units.source_text: 她父亲和八亲王原是兄弟。”

en.t: Her father and the Eighth Prince were brothers, after all.”

units.source_text: 他好色的老毛病还是不改，为了恋慕浮舟，

en.t: His old weakness for women had still not changed, and because of his longing for Ukifune,

units.source_text: 便希望看看宫君。

en.t: he began to wish that he could see Miya no Kimi.

units.source_text: 他念念不忘，总想早点看到她。

en.t: He could not stop thinking about it and was always eager to see her as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 薰大将闻知宫君当了宫女，想道：“这真是岂有此理之事啊！

en.t: When General Kaoru heard that Miya no Kimi had become a lady-in-waiting, he thought, “This is truly outrageous!

units.source_text: 她父亲曾想把她嫁给皇太子，

en.t: Her father once wanted to marry her to the Crown Prince,

units.source_text: 又曾表示想把她嫁给我，还是昨今之事呢！

en.t: and he also said he wished to marry her to me, and that was only very recently!

units.source_text: 世事无常，逢到了衰运，还不如投身水底，也可免受讥评。”

en.t: The world is uncertain; when misfortune comes, it may be better to throw oneself beneath the water and so escape people’s scorn.”

units.source_text: 他对宫君的同情比别人更深。

en.t: His sympathy for Miya no Kimi was deeper than anyone else’s.
